content: Taking certain medications can increase your risk of experiencing serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your healthcare provider. Other medications that may affect kidney function or hearing could increase the risk of kidney damage or hearing loss when taken with neomycin. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. While taking this medication, your healthcare provider may recommend laboratory or medical tests, such as hearing evaluations or kidney function tests, to monitor your health. If you miss a dose of this medication before a scheduled surgery to prevent infection, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, continue with your regular dosing schedule and consult your doctor or pharmacist for further instructions. If you are taking this medication to treat hepatic encephalopathy and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the regular time. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For guidance on disposal, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is important to note that this document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
